name: humanizer
description: Agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text
one_liner: An AI-writing add-on that rewrites text so it reads less like it came from ChatGPT — smoothing out the telltale patterns AI detectors and readers both notice.
buyer: A content marketer or SEO agency worried that obviously AI-sounding copy hurts reader trust or search rankings, who wants their AI-drafted content to read more naturally.
business_use_cases: A content agency runs all AI-drafted blog posts through it before publishing to sound more natural to readers.
A solo newsletter writer uses it to polish AI-assisted drafts into their own voice.
A marketing team uses it to make AI-generated ad copy sound less robotic in A/B tests.

money_ideas.idea: Wrap it as a hosted 'humanize my draft' web tool with a monthly content quota for solo creators and small agencies.

steal_this: Be honest that this sits in a gray area: legitimate use is making stiff AI copy read naturally, but the same tool can be used to evade academic-integrity or AI-disclosure checks — build the honest version (marketing copy polish) and skip any 'beat the detector for schoolwork' framing.
